headline: Trump administration launches America.gov AI chatbot portal
summary: The Trump administration launched America.gov, envisioned as the main AI chatbot portal for federal services, powered by Gemini and Grok. One report describes the site as unfinished and poorly designed, a critical framing not found in other coverage.

claims.statement: The Trump administration launched America.gov as an official US government AI chatbot portal for federal services.

sources.quote: There's now an official US government AI chatbot
The administration wants America.gov to be the main portal for federal services.
Trump launches America.gov with AI chatbots at its core

claims.statement: The site uses Gemini and Grok chatbots as the front door to federal resources.

sources.quote: Gemini, Grok now serving as front door to federal resources on unfinished, poorly designed website

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet characterizes the new site as unfinished and poorly designed, a critical framing not present in the other's neutral description.
